svg.title: Dibrugarh University — pixel atlas, campus and 500 metre surroundings
svg.desc: Geographic review preview. All downloaded OpenStreetMap roads in the buffer are retained. Campus extent is approximate and includes a georeferenced 2020 audit outline; not a cadastral survey. Tree symbols are decorative.
svg.text: 207 source road ways · 4,030 building footprints · 91 source names
© OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) · Overture Maps Foundation · Google Open Buildings / Microsoft · DU Green and Carbon Audit 2020, p30
Review draft: source labels may be misplaced or duplicated; historical terrain and boundary need field verification. Decorative trees do not locate real trees. Not a complete Google Maps inventory.
